stories.headline: FOMC meets Jul 28-29, rate decision Wed 2:00 PM ET
stories.one_line: Non-SEP meeting; market-implied ~80-90% odds of a hold at 3.50-3.75%; Powell's tone is the real signal since no dot plot is published.
stories.score_note: Highest-importance scheduled event of the week; drives rates and equities broadly.

stories.headline: Microsoft, Meta, Arm, Apple, Amazon report Wed/Thu into AI-capex scrutiny
stories.one_line: Recent pattern of markets punishing AI spenders on capex/FCF even with in-line results (cited re: Alphabet); watching whether it repeats.
stories.score_note: Concentrated index-level risk given combined mega-cap weight.

stories.headline: US-Iran ceasefire holds but Hormuz/reparations/missile disputes unresolved
stories.one_line: Ceasefire since Apr 8 (extended indefinitely Apr 21) holding through a second quiet day Jul 26; Strait of Hormuz toll regime, missile program, and reparations remain unresolved.

stories.headline: Iran alleges Ukrainian strike on commercial vessel in Caspian Sea
stories.one_line: Iran claims one sailor killed; not yet independently corroborated by a second source this run — treat as allegation pending confirmation.
stories.score_note: Escalation risk for the broader ceasefire; watch for second-source confirmation.

stories.headline: Q2 2026 GDP advance estimate, Thu Jul 30 8:30 ET
stories.one_line: First growth read for Q2, landing one day after the FOMC decision.

stories.headline: Employment Cost Index Q2 2026, Fri Jul 31 8:30 ET
stories.one_line: Fed's preferred wage-inflation gauge, closes out the week's data calendar.

stories.headline: SpaceX Starship Flight 13 mostly successful — first flight since IPO
stories.one_line: Jul 24 flight: all 33 first-stage engines nominal, 20 Starlink V3 sats deployed, intact heatshield through splashdown.
stories.score_note: Backdrop/context item, not this-week catalyst; kept on watchlist for continued public-company technical track record.

stories.headline: Active ransomware/zero-day campaigns: Fairlife/Coca-Cola, Abbott, Cl0p Windchill, SonicWall
stories.one_line: Coca-Cola's Fairlife breach (8-K filed Jul 16, listed by Anubis Jul 20) and Abbott (ShinyHunters) are the two watchlist-relevant incidents; broader Cl0p/SonicWall campaigns are industry-wide.
stories.score_note: Background single-name risk across the watchlist.

stories.headline: OpenAI reported preparing confidential IPO filing, possible Sept 2026 listing
stories.one_line: Press-reported only, not confirmed on public EDGAR; consistent with existing registry entry. Watch the weekly Saturday EDGAR sweep for any status change.
